source.author: verg
source.text: Vos et Scyllaeam rabiem penitusque sonantis accestis scopulos, vos et Cyclopea saxa experti: revocate animos, maestumque timorem mittite: forsan et haec olim meminisse iuvabit.
source.text_original: Vos et Scyllaeam rabiem penitusque sonantis / accestis scopulos, vos et Cyclopea saxa / experti: revocate animos, maestumque timorem / mittite: forsan et haec olim meminisse iuvabit.
source.text_english: You too have come near the Scyllaean frenzy and the rocks that roar from deep within; you too have faced the Cyclopean cliffs. Take heart again, and put away your sorrowful fear: perhaps someday it will even be a joy to remember these things.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: mitte metus, volat ille mari quantumque propinquat, iam magis atque magis variis stupet Aea deorum prodigiis quatiuntque truces oracula Colchos.
reuse.text_original: 'mitte metus, volat ille mari quantumque propinquat, / iam magis atque magis variis stupet Aea deorum / prodigiis quatiuntque truces oracula Colchos.
reuse.text_english: Dismiss your fears; he is flying over the sea, and the nearer he draws, the more and more Aea is amazed at the various portents of the gods, and the fierce oracles shake the Colchians.
